headline: Simbhaoli Sugars enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process; creditor list filed
sum: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited initiated formal CIRP under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, with the exchange notified of creditor disclosures on 21 July 2026.
detail: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited, a listed sugar and co-products manufacturer based in Uttar Pradesh, has entered the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) as mandated under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The National Stock Exchange intimation of 21 July 2026 confirms filing of the creditor list, a mandatory disclosure step in the CIRP workflow. The creditor list forms the basis for claims admission, voting rights in the Committee of Creditors (CoC), and the resolution plan evaluation process.
